segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: We now present the Department's proposed 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: The DOE's revenue collection for the national government have consistently exceeded its approved budget.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: Collections were driven mainly by the Malampaya Gas Fund.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: Its decline, however, was offset by improved collections from RE sources.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: For 2026, the total projected revenue collection is 6.06 billion.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: For 2027, revenues are projected to reach 23 billion, mainly because of Malampaya Phase 4.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: RE collections are also expected to continue increasing.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Since there's no other senator, I'll just ask my quick questions.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I think it's interesting to emphasize that the revenues of DOE are predominantly from Malampaya Gas Fund.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then from 2026 to 2027, it's still very high, almost to the 2023 levels.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then your others, what are they?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So talagang ang laking bagay nung sa Malampaya.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Of course, I have to say that because ako'y nag-sponsor niyan and pinaglaban natin niyan.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: And in fact, 2028 will likely go up because of the new discovery.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, the DOE's total proposed budget is 5.58 billion, reflecting an increase of 1.14 billion or 25.7%.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: Compared with fiscal year 2026 GA of 4.43 billion.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: From 2022 to 2026, new appropriations generally maintained the largest share in the DOE's total budget, from 59.4 to 68.9%, versus automatic appropriations of about 31.1 to 40.6%.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: But for 2027, new appropriations decreased by ₱935 million.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: And account for only 36.4% of the total recommended budget, while 63.6% comes from the SAGF.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
segments.text: In other words, the department's budgetary requirements will be heavily supported through the SAGF, sourced from the revenues from energy service contracts and other collections of the department.

segments.speaker: DOE Undersecretary Giovanni Carlo J. Bacordo
Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Before you leave again, I just want to comment.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, for the first time since 2022, which is the last six years, the new appropriations will actually be less.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: This is very important because basically, DOE is more self-sustaining than you were in the past.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And I think compared to many other agencies, malaking bagay yun na.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, it's really something that I wanted to emphasize.

segments.text: And as you said, the reason is, meron kayong revenues na pumapasok to support this.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Bakit po sa Pampanga, sila doon, nasa 9 pesos lang po per kilowatt hour. Why is that?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Bakit po sa Visayas, Mindanao, napakamahal?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Pampanga, nasa 9 pesos. Dito sa Metro Manila, hindi ko na alam. Magkano po ba ang singil sa atin sa Metro Manila, sir, per kilowatt hour?

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Depende na po yan doon sa utility at kung saan kumukuha yung utility.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Yes, totoo po na nakita natin in August, yung lumabas nga na presyo market clearing sa Luzon is at around 4 pesos.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: And yet, doon sa Visayas and Mindanao, mabot ng 18.19.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Yun pong ating WESM, ito po, bukod doon sa prinsipyo ng locational marginal pricing, meron po tayo yung tinatawag na gross pool.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ibig sabihin po, lahat ng generators obligado sila to offer yung kanilang available capacity sa WESM at kung ang offer nila ay papasok doon sa mga offers na makakasama sa dispatch schedule,

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: depende kasi naman niya doon sa demand at that moment.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Sila ay makakasama sa dispatch o doon sa mga ipapatakbo ng SO na mga planta.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pero po ang bayaran sa kanila ay hindi base doon sa presyo necessarily na lalabas sa merkado dahil yung mga ibang generators dito ay contracted bilaterally.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya't yung kanilang naibentang or naisupply na kuryente during that interval, kung pwedeng ang presyo niyan ay yung kanilang bilateral contract with an off-taker and it will be settled.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: At pagdating naman po sa offers natin, wala po tayo yung nire-require na yung kanilang offer ay dapat base doon sa kanilang cost.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ito po ay kanilang desisyon na kung ano ang kanilang i-offer but normally in a competitive market, kung ikaw ay mag-offer at ang gusto mo ay makabawi ng at least yung marginal cost.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: So mag-offer ka ng at least yung fuel and operating cost.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ay mabawi mo itong gagastusin mo kapag ka ikaw ay natawag at nag-generate ng kuryente, yung iyong capital cost maaaring hindi mo mabawi.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pero during times naman na yung mag-clear na presyo ay mas mataas kaysa doon sa marginal cost mo at mas mataas kaysa dito na meron pang kasama na po pwedeng makarecover ka ng capital fee mo or cost mo, doon yung mga panahon na ikaw ay nakakarecover.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya't meron po tayong mga ilang coal plants na maaaring ang kanilang...

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Ang presyo during the time na sila ay nakasama doon sa dispatch schedule ay mas mataas kaysa doon sa kanilang all-in na presyo nasa 6 o 7 dahil ang nag-clear na presyo ay mas mataas dito, mabot ng 32 which is our primary cap in WESM.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Pero hindi necessarily na yun ang ibabayad sa kanila dahil po maaaring sila naman as sa baseload plants, kakailanganin naman po nila ng kontrata.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Nang sa ganon, masisiguro nila na lagi silang kinakailangan tumakbo dahil hindi naman po sila po pwede na magpatay sinde ng kanilang planta at ito naman po ang makakapekto sa operasyon nila.

segments.speaker: ERC Chairperson and CEO Francis Saturnino C. Juan
segments.text: Kaya't sisiguruhin nila na sila ay lagi makakasama doon sa dispatch dahil sila ay meron mga kontrata rin na kailangan servisyohan po.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Tama po kayo pero will you agree with me na this is all market driven?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Kung ano kasi the demand is great?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Maski hindi naman po kinakailangan, wala pong iniwan. Parang po karne ng manok, karne ng baboy. May African swine fever isang lugar pero kailangan mo magdala doon dahil walang supply ng baboy so tataas ang baboy when in fact it's not supposed to.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Or isang lugar na galunggong is so mura dahil walang supply ng galunggong pero may dumating na galunggong so tataas yung presyo because the demand is great.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Yung po yung sinasabi ko Chairperson Juan and Madam Secretary, we have to check itong WESM. So po pwede ho eh kung titignan ho natin, pag-aralan lang ho siguro ninyo, take time na pag-aralan ho itong po ang problema natin sa generation, hindi po sa distribution.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: It's not Meralco, it's not Samelco, it's not the cooperative but the generator yung nagpo-produce ng kuryente para for distribution. Doon po ang problema because sobrang sipa ng presyo kagaya po niyan, full siya but then again parang banker fuel ang presyo niya.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Sa sabihin po, barko. Kailangan pumantay dahil doon sa fuel ng barko kaya sobrang taas. Masyado pong exorbitant.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: I think once in a while you have to look into this siguro Atty. Juan kasi parang ang kawaba po dito yung mga tao. Kailangan lang po nalaga natin, imonitor siguro Atty. Juan para ikang pag-alam ng WESM na minomonitor sila, chinecheck sila, then siyempre magdadahan-dahan kasi po kailangan po natin ang goal po natin lahat tayo dito, si Chairperson Pia, si Senate President, we're all looking for ways.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: How to bring our electricity rate down. Lahat naman po tayo kasi tayo po pinakamahal sa Southeast Asia. I mean meron naman pa lang, meron pong pamamaraan. I know there's a way. If we just look, we just do natin simulan sa power generation.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Huwag po natin sisihin ang Meralco, huwag po natin sisihin itong mga electric cooperatives dahil bumibili lang po sila ng power. Yung po nagma-manufacture. Doon po yun eh.

segments.text: Kasi 4 pesos, 5 pesos versus bunker fuel. I understand what Secretary Garin is saying. segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: Para yung mauna yung mga mas mura mabenta. So we've been studying this. Actually, we just had a meeting yesterday na rin kung ano pang pwedeng intervention. But good enough, ERC already issued a price cap. So from 18 magiging 11 na lang yata siya. Magiging 8 pesos.

segments.speaker: DOE Secretary Sharon S. Garin
segments.text: But still, the abuse of the market should not. Because these are public service.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: May pahabol ako, Madam Chairperson. Thank you po, Attorney Juan, for doing that. It's ika nga kahit papaano, you're looking for ways right now para matulungan po ang kababayan natin.
